entities.name: Erik Ågren
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Erik Alfred Ågren was a Swedish amateur boxer. He won a bronze medal in the lightweight division at the 1936 Summer Olympics and a silver medal as a welterweight at the 1939 European Amateur Boxing Championships.
